mapper.update: UPDATE agent_executions SET status=#{status},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, duration_ms=GREATEST(0,DATEDIFF('MILLISECOND',started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)),error=#{error},result=#{result}, approved=#{metrics.approved,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},issue_count=#{metrics.issueCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, major_change=#{metrics.majorChange,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},body_characters=#{metrics.bodyCharacters,jdbcType=INTEGER}, fact_count=#{metrics.factCount,jdbcType=INTEGER},relation_count=#{metrics.relationCount,jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
UPDATE agent_executions SET status='INTERRUPTED',error='服务中断，执行结束时间未知' WHERE status='RUNNING'

UPDATE agent_executions SET status=#{status},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), duration_ms=GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) DIV 1000),error=#{error},result=#{result}, approved=#{metrics.approved,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},issue_count=#{metrics.issueCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, major_change=#{metrics.majorChange,jdbcType=BOOLEAN},body_characters=#{metrics.bodyCharacters,jdbcType=INTEGER}, fact_count=#{metrics.factCount,jdbcType=INTEGER},relation_count=#{metrics.relationCount,jdbcType=INTEGER} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING'
mapper.sql: SELECT task_id,COUNT(*) AS execution_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status='INTERRUPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS interrupted_count, SUM(duration_ms) AS execution_ms,COUNT(duration_ms) AS timed_executions,SUM(queue_ms) AS queue_ms, MAX(CASE WHEN approved=TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_reviews, MAX(CASE WHEN approved=FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_reviews, MAX(COALESCE(issue_count,0)) AS issue_count FROM agent_executions GROUP BY task_id
mapper.select: SELECT t.kind,COUNT(*) AS task_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_tasks, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status='RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running_tasks, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(1,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM model_call_turns r WHERE r.call_id=c.id)) END),0) AS model_calls,COALESCE(SUM(c.input_tokens),0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(c.output_tokens),0) AS output_tokens,SUM(c.cached_input_tokens) AS cached_input_tokens, COUNT(c.cached_input_tokens) AS cache_reported_calls, COALESCE(SUM(c.actual),0) AS settled_cost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.actual IS NULL AND c.status<>'REJECTED' THEN c.reserved ELSE 0 END),0) AS pending_reservation, COALESCE(SUM(e.execution_count),0) AS execution_count,COALESCE(SUM(e.interrupted_count),0) AS interrupted_count, SUM(e.execution_ms) AS execution_ms,COALESCE(SUM(e.timed_executions),0) AS timed_executions, SUM(e.queue_ms) AS queue_ms,COALESCE(SUM(e.passed_reviews),0) AS passed_reviews, COALESCE(SUM(e.rejected_reviews),0) AS rejected_reviews,COALESCE(SUM(e.issue_count),0) AS issue_count, SUM(c.latency_ms) AS model_ms,COUNT(c.latency_ms) AS timed_calls, AVG(f.rating) AS human_rating,COUNT(f.rating) AS rated_tasks FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN model_calls c ON c.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN () e ON e.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN agent_feedback f ON f.task_id=t.id AND f.id=(SELECT MAX(f2.id) FROM agent_feedback f2 WHERE f2.task_id=t.id) GROUP BY t.kind ORDER BY t.kind

SELECT t.id,t.novel_id,n.title AS novel_title,t.kind,t.status,t.chapter_no,t.revision,t.memory_version, t.created_at,t.updated_at,t.error,c.id AS call_id,c.status AS call_status,c.model,c.provider,c.billing_mode, c.actual,c.reserved,c.input_tokens,c.output_tokens,c.cached_input_tokens,c.latency_ms, e.execution_count,e.execution_ms,e.interrupted_count, (SELECT rating FROM agent_feedback f WHERE f.task_id=t.id ORDER BY f.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS human_rating FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN novels n ON n.id=t.novel_id LEFT JOIN model_calls c ON c.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN () e ON e.task_id=t.id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT t.*,n.title AS novel_title FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN novels n ON n.id=t.novel_id WHERE t.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM agent_executions WHERE task_id=#{id} ORDER BY started_at,id

SELECT t.id,t.kind,t.status,t.error,t.created_at,t.updated_at,e.id AS execution_id,e.started_at,e.finished_at, CASE WHEN e.status='RUNNING' THEN GREATEST(0,DATEDIFF('MILLISECOND',e.started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ELSE e.duration_ms END AS elapsed_ms, GREATEST(0,DATEDIFF('MILLISECOND',t.created_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS task_age_ms, c.id AS call_id,c.status AS call_status,c.provider,c.model,c.actual,c.reserved,c.input_tokens,c.output_tokens, CASE WHEN c.status='IN_FLIGHT' THEN GREATEST(0,DATEDIFF('MILLISECOND',c.created_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) ELSE c.latency_ms END AS model_elapsed_ms FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN model_calls c ON c.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN agent_executions e ON e.task_id=t.id AND e.id=(SELECT e2.id FROM agent_executions e2 WHERE e2.task_id=t.id ORDER BY e2.started_at DESC,e2.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE t.id=#{id}
SELECT id,type,message,created_at,execution_id FROM events WHERE task_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT t.id,t.kind,t.status,t.error,t.created_at,t.updated_at,e.id AS execution_id,e.started_at,e.finished_at, CASE WHEN e.status='RUNNING' THEN GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,e.started_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) DIV 1000) ELSE e.duration_ms END AS elapsed_ms, GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,t.created_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) DIV 1000) AS task_age_ms, c.id AS call_id,c.status AS call_status,c.provider,c.model,c.actual,c.reserved,c.input_tokens,c.output_tokens, CASE WHEN c.status='IN_FLIGHT' THEN GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND,c.created_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) DIV 1000) ELSE c.latency_ms END AS model_elapsed_ms FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN model_calls c ON c.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN agent_executions e ON e.task_id=t.id AND e.id=(SELECT e2.id FROM agent_executions e2 WHERE e2.task_id=t.id ORDER BY e2.started_at DESC,e2.id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE t.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM events WHERE task_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT * FROM agent_feedback WHERE task_id=#{id} ORDER BY id DESC
